content:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: billing-reports-eu1 detected increased token-count drift and delayed usage emits. Priority: P1. Alerts: overage flags firing for ~12 customers. Start triage.
lee: on it — what's the immediate customer impact?
maria: looking... kafka consumer lag on topic billing-emit-eu1 is ~120s and growing, aggregator backpressure visible in logs.
maria: snippet from consumer: ```ConsumerGroup metrics: lag=123456, partitions=24, last_offset=987654321```
billing_engineer: confirmed some overage flags came from the downstream tallyer reading duplicate windowed emits. Seeing ~6% token inflation for affected accounts. Customers in EU region only so far.
sre_oncall: okay, can we stop downstream overage notifications while we investigate? runbook suggests suppressing alerts + backfill. link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/billing-emit-issue
product_ops: agree. We should pause customer alerts and send a short note if we confirm persistent incorrect billing.
billing_engineer: I can toggle supression flag on the alerts service. Command: `kubectl -n billing exec svc/alerts -- toggle-suppression --scope=region:eu1 --reason="emit-lag-p1"`
lee: do it and confirm here. Also check if the emitter is re-trying duplicates (replay logic).
billing_engineer: suppression toggled :white_check_mark: (alerts.svc -> region=eu1). Will keep alerting to internal channel only.
maria: restarted consumer group consumer-emit-eu1 (rolling restart). Watching lag.
maria: tail logs: `emit-handler: processed window 2022-12-31T23:59:00Z, delta_tokens=+0` — lag dropping to ~30s now.
sre_oncall: good. Let's also enable dedupe guard on tallyer for the next 30m to avoid flash overcharges. I can flip an env flag: `DEDUPE_WINDOW_MS=60000`.
billing_engineer: dedupe guard enabled, will monitor for false negatives.
product_ops: what's the timeline for backfill? customers are already seeing overage emails.
billing_engineer: plan: suppress external emails now, let systems settle for 15m, then run reconciliation backfill job `billing-recon --window=1h --region=eu1 --mode=simulate` first to estimate delta. If deltas look safe, run actual backfill.
derek: jumping in as on-call for next 2 hours. handing off from lee. Is there anything unresolved?
lee: handoff: consumer lag caused duplicate emits -> temporary alert suppression + dedupe guard + consumer restart. Backfill in simulation started after 15m. Current status: lag trending down, overage alerts suppressed.
derek: acknowledged. I'll keep monitoring and coordinate customer comms if simulation shows persistent charge drift. ping me @derek for escalations.
incidents-bot: Incident logged: INC-20221231-1640995300. Status: mitigation in progress. Assigned: derek.
product_ops: draft for customer notice in #support-desk: "We're investigating delayed usage reporting in EU region that may cause temporary overage notifications. We've suppressed external billing alerts while we reconcile. We'll follow up within 2 hours with next steps"
derek: copy. I'll update after simulation run (ETA ~20m).
billing_engineer: starting simulation now. `billing-recon --window=1h --region=eu1 --mode=simulate`
maria: lag at ~8s, consumer stable.
derek: thanks — keeping this open until backfill completed and we confirm no leftover drift. :eyes:
